# miband

Xiaomi Smart Band command-line client. Reads data that Mi Fitness synced to the Xiaomi cloud: devices, steps, sleep, heart rate, SpO2, stress, workouts with raw per-second record and GPS. Pure Go, no Bluetooth, no cgo.

## Installation

```bash
make install  # from a checkout
```

## Quick Usage

```bash
miband login --user you@example.com
miband devices
miband data
miband data --days 0 --kind steps --did 123456789 -f json
miband data --kind workouts --details -f json
miband data --kind heart_rate,spo2 --raw
```

## Commands

- login - log into the Xiaomi account and save the session; prompts (stderr, answers from stdin lines) for region unless --region, account unless --user, password unless MIBAND_PASSWORD (no-echo on TTY), and the email code of a security check (3 tries, empty answers re-asked; a refused check prints the browser URL); or --user-id with --pass-token (cookies of account.xiaomi.com after browser verification)
- logout - end the saved pass token's session on account.xiaomi.com (GET /pass/logout), then remove the session file; the file is removed even if the server call fails (exit 1 then); prints "not logged in" and exits 0 when there is none
- devices - list devices bound to the account: did, model, name, mac, sn
- data - fetch records; --days (7, 0..3650, from local midnight, today included), --kind (steps,sleep,workouts or any record key such as heart_rate, spo2, stress, calories, watch_night_sleep), --did (one device), --details (download and decode workout record/gps/recover_rate files), --raw (records as stored, including tombstones)

## Global Flags

-f/--format (markdown; markdown|json), --region (saved login, else China), -u/--user, --user-id, --pass-token, -v/--verbose (log endpoints and sizes to stderr)

## Environment Variables

MIBAND_PASSWORD - password for login --user.

## Output Formats

- markdown - default; heading per section, tables; workout detail files listed by name
- json - pretty-printed, every field, decoded workout detail files

## Session

Saved with mode 0600 to os.UserConfigDir()/miband/cloud.json; expired service token is refreshed once with the saved pass token.

## Exit Codes

0 ok, 1 error, 3 auth error (not logged in, unknown account, wrong password, verification required, token rejected), 130 SIGINT/SIGTERM
